1.description: [Elune] - Empowered Healing Touch through Grove Ranger now heals an additional target.
[Elune] - Renewing Light now Stacks up to 30 times, up from 15.
[Elune] - Loa's Assault now deals 175% weapon damage. Up from 160%.
[Elune] - Divine Wrath now increases the damage of your next Smite or Holy Fire by 30%. Up from 15%.
[Elune] [Razor Claws] - Now grants 2% Physical damage per stack, up from 1%.
[Elune] [Prophet of Wrath] - Crusader Strike and Divine Storm now also extend the duration of Divine Illumination by 2 seconds.
[Area-52] [Elune] - [Honed Ice] - Now increases both melee and ranged critical strike chance.
[Elune] - Flame Born now also increases the periodic damage of your Shadowflame by 15%.

[Elune] [Biting Cold] - Now stacks up to 3, down from 5. It now increases the critical strike chance of Ice Lance by 8% per stack, up from 5%. And increases the damage of Ice Lance by 17% per stack, up from 10%.
[Elune] - Wacky Wizardry,Eccentric Elementalist,Deranged Druid,Crazy Cultist,Zany Zealot now have a 15% chance to trigger.
[Elune] - Frostflame Shock now lasts 18 seconds and its cast time was reduced to 1.5 second. Changed from 12/2 sec respectively.
[Elune] - Conductor now also affects Lava Burst and additionally increases the damage done to monsters by 40% per stack.
[Elune] - Elemental Destruction now increases the duration of your Flame Shock by 50%.
[Elune] [Harvest Essence] - Death Coil can now trigger Harvest Essence.
[Elune] [Biting Drain] - Now also increases the critical strike damage bonus of Drain Soul in addition to Drain Life by 35%.
[Elune] - [Seismic Spite] - Lava Lash, Ice Lash, Lava Sweep, Sundering now all grant 1 charge of Hate. Upheaval and Ground Slam still grant 2 charges.
[Elune] - [Shattering Slam] - Reaching 10 stacks of Seething Growth now also increases the critical damage and critical strike chance of your next Sundering or Ground Slam by 25%.

[Elune] - Shield of the Emperor no longer triggers Avatar, it now extends the duration of your next Avatar by 2 seconds stacking up to 5 times. If Avatar is already active it also extends the duration by 3 seconds.
[Elune] - Assault and Battery can now be triggered by Shield Slam.
[Elune] - Fixed a bug causing Goldrinn's Fury cooldown reduction to not always work properly with Mind Flay on high stacks of Goldrinn's Focus.
[Elune] - Fixed a bug causing high Goldrinn's Focus stacked Mind Flays to not always generate the proper amount of Soul Fragments.
[Elune] - Mutilate now deals 5% increased damage for each of your Poisons on the target. Changed from flat 10% on poisoned targets.
[Elune] [Area-52] - Fixed a bug causing Thrust to deal lower damage then intended.
[Elune] - Piercing Cleaver now stacks up to 5 times, up from 3.
[Elune] - Piercing Cleaver's cooldown has been reduced to 3 seconds, down from 6.
[Elune] - Ragefire Cleave now triggers on 6 stacks and its damage has been increased by 100%.
[Elune] - Ragefire Cleave now has 6 stacks, each stack increases melee attack speed by 2% down from 3%.
[Elune] - Accelerated Ascension now also increases the damage of your Holy Fire damage over time by 50%.
[Elune] - Increased base damage and scaling of Barrage Overload by 30%.
[Elune] - Sinister Flurry triggered damage now hits all enemies in a cone.
[Elune] - Increased base damage and scaling of Lunar Burn by 1000%.
[Elune] - Increased base damage and scaling of Lunar Spirits by 100%.
[Elune] - Arcane Motes now also increase the damage of Arcane Explosion by 5% per stack.
[Elune] - Starburst Barrage now increases its damage by 100% each tick.
[Elune] - Raging Fire Nova now also reduces the cooldown of Fire Nova by 2 seconds.
[Elune] - Pyrolysis now also increases critical strike damage bonus and now also affects Incinerate in addition to Soul Fire.
[Elune] - Inner Flame proc now also enables your Holy Fire to chain to 2 nearby enemies.
[Elune] [Locust Resurgence] - Can now be triggered by dealing damage with Toxic Surge.
[Elune] - Increased the damage of Arcane Aiming by 30%, and it now generates 6% of the casters mana, up from 3%.
[Elune] - Arc Aim Shot - Now has 3 stacks, down from 5. Now increases the damage of Arcane Shot by 25%, up from 15%.
[Elune] - Slice and Ices energize effect has been increased to 40 energy over 8 seconds.
[Elune] - Increased base damage and scaling of Frost Pulse on the cleaved targets by 100%.
[Elune] - Wrath of the Sun now also reduces the global cooldown of your Wrath by 30%.
[Elune] - Wrath can now also trigger Astral Fusion.
[Elune] - Infused Energy now has 1 charge, and gains a 15/30/45% damage increase, and 15/30/45 energy reduction per stack.
